resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and firelookout.com give 1932, but a September 1927 letter to the Secretary of the Interior says a 42-foot tower and cabin had been erected, an August 1928 report describes work on the tower, and a May 1925 newspaper item says a lookout point had been found on Fern Top with a lookout to be stationed there that summer. The story reports the 1925 item as the earliest documentation, the 1927 letter as the earliest description of a tower, and the 1932 claim, and does not choose a build year.
Register and firelookout.com list Coos FPA; the 1920s-30s letters and newspaper items name the Siuslaw National Forest. Both are reported; the story does not pick one.

notes_for_editor: Build date unresolved: the September 1927 letter says erected, the register and firelookout.com say 1932; a May 1925 newspaper item predates both and is now the story's earliest documentation (the draft had wrongly called the 1927 letter the earliest). The story reports these and does not choose. The brief records no build date, so no correction is proposed. Height 12.8 m matches the 42-foot figure in the 1927 letter. No source describes the site today or public access; access and visit are omitted. The 1936 survey-disk line is a description, not evidence that the disk survives. Used 2 WebSearch queries (nothing on the current site) and 3 page reads. No photos added; the register's 1944 photo is already on its page.
